title: A filter on the far end of a chain of one-to-many relationships reaches the fact table

source.quote: Filters will propagate so long as there's a relationship path to follow, which can involve propagation to multiple tables
source.supports: propagation follows the whole relationship path Category -> Subcategory -> Product -> Sales

source.quote: The filter on the Category table propagates to the Product table
source.supports: the page walks a Category filter through Product to Sales

source.quote: If all expressions evaluate to BLANK for a row, that row is not included in the table returned
source.supports: Clothing has no sales, its Amount is BLANK and the row is left out

derivation: Bikes has subcategories Road (10) and Mountain (11), with products 100, 101, 102: Sales rows 1, 2, 3, 4 = 500 + 1000 + 700 + 900 = 3100. Parts has Brakes (20) and Chains (21), with products 103, 104: rows 5, 6 = 50 + 20 = 70. Clothing has no subcategory, so no sales: BLANK, row removed.
